question: What consequence follows from constructing a fire-pit without the yoni feature?
premises: The yoni is a required feature of the fire-pit.
A fire-pit may be made without it.
Such a fire-pit is declared to destroy the wife.
inference: A fire-pit made without a yoni is said to bring destruction to the wife.
plain_english: A fire-pit made without a yoni is declared to bring destruction to the wife.
